data.name: Fatmeh
data.gender_notes: Fatmeh is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Fatmeh is a revered name in Islamic tradition, derived from the Arabic word for 'abundance' or 'wealth'. It is also associated with Fatimah, the daughter of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Fatmeh carries the meaning “Abundance” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fatmeh usually hope their child will grow to embody abundance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Fatmeh is considered a blessed name, as it is associated with Fatimah, known for her piety and kindness.
data.etymology: Fatmeh belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Abundance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fatmeh total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: فاطمه
in_arabic.meaning: اسماء بنت الرسول، ابوها خديجة و امها السيدة مريم عليها السلام
in_arabic.long_meaning: فاطمه اسم مبارك مشتق من الفطام، تعني مفطومة من النار أو من كل شر، و هي ابنة الرسول صلى الله عليه و سلم و زوجة علي بن أبي طالب، و أم سيدنا الحسن و الحسين، و هي سيدة نساء أهل الجنة

in_urdu.name: فاطمہ
in_urdu.meaning: رسول اللہ کی بیٹی، خدیجہ اور مریم کا بچہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: فاطمہ ایک مبارک نام ہے جو الفطام سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے النار سے مفطوم یا ہر شر سے مفطوم، اور یہ رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم کی بیٹی اور علی بن ابی طالب کی زوجہ اور سیدنا حسن و حسین کی والدہ ہیں، اور وہ جنت میں خواتین کی سرتاج ہیں

in_hindi.name: फातिमा
in_hindi.meaning: रासुअल अल्लाह की बेटी, खदीजा और मरीयम का बच्चा
in_hindi.long_meaning: फातिमा एक पवित्र नाम है जो अल्फिताम से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है आग से मुक्त या हर बुराई से मुक्त, और यह रासुअल अल्लाह की बेटी और अली बिन अबी तालिब की पत्नी और हज़रत हसन और हुसैन की माता हैं, और वह जन्नत में महिलाओं की मालक हैं

in_pashto.name: فاطمه
in_pashto.meaning: د رسول الله لورۍ، خدیجہ او مریم ماشوم
in_pashto.long_meaning: فاطمه يو مبارک نوم دی چی د الفطام نه اخستل سوی دی، معنی یی دے چی له اوره نه مفطومه یا له هر شر نه مفطومه، او دا د رسول الله صلی الله عليه وسلم لورۍ او د علی بن ابی طالب میرمنه او د سيدنا حسن او حسین مورده ده، او هغه په جنت کې د ښځو سرتاج ده

in_english.name: Fatmeh
in_english.meaning: Daughter of Prophet Muhammad, a virtuous and noble lady
in_english.long_meaning: The name Fatmeh originates from Arabic roots, specifically from the term 'fıtıme', which implies weaning or abstinence from something. In Islamic tradition, Fatmeh is the name of the daughter of Prophet Muhammad, the wife of Ali ibn Abi Talib, and the mother of Hasan and Husayn. She is regarded as the leader of the women in Paradise. The name symbolizes spiritual growth, piety, and nobility.

data.cultural_impact: Fatmeh is a uniquely beautiful and evocative Islamic name, often used by Muslims worldwide as a symbol of aspiration and reverence, inspired by the rich legacy of Islamic history and culture. The name has a profound significance in the Islamic world due to its association with Fatimah bint Muhammad, who is considered an undying symbol of love, devotion, and bravery. In many Muslim households and communities, the name Fatmeh is cherished and passed down through generations as a sign of Islamic heritage and pride. Moreover, growing up with a name like Fatmeh can serve as a constant reminder of the admirable qualities of Fatimah and inspire one to aspire towards a life of courage, compassion, and faith.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic tradition, the name Fatmeh has deep spiritual resonance as it is derived from the Arabic word for 'abundance' or 'wealth.' This fundamental meaning is a reflection of the spiritual riches and blessings that come through faith in Allah and devotion to His Prophet Muhammad and the guidance and wisdom of the Imāmah of Fatimah. The spiritual significance of the name is underscored by its association with the life and legacy of Fatimah, the cherished and beloved daughter of the Prophet Muhammad, who is considered the paragon of moral excellence, exemplary wife, and noble matriarch for Muslims. The name Fatmeh therefore serves as a powerful reminder of the generous blessings of Allah, the role models from our sacred history, and the potential for personal growth and spiritual enrichment that comes through the embodiment of these noble values.
